profile.headline: Frontend Software Engineer @ iManage | Purdue CS Alum
profile.summary:
I'm a full-stack engineer based in Chicago.

Background in web and mobile app development. Experience with Java, C#, C, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Dart, Flutter, .NET Core/Framework, SQL.

Bachelor of Science from Purdue University. Major in computer science with a specialization in software engineering and with minors in math and Spanish.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Served as a UTA for a Software Engineering Computer science course. This was a capstone class, where students had the whole semester to build a project, modeling industry experience with Agile development. I oversaw three teams building 3 different web applications using technologies React, HTML/CSS, NodeJS, Python, PostGreSQL, Firebase, JS/TS. 

Served as a UTA for an introductory Computer Science course at Purdue University that covered topics such as Git, Github, bash commands, and professional development. Held review sessions, assisted students in understanding course material, and graded assignments.

positions.title: Project Partner Liaison, Software Developer
positions.description:
-Worked on a team to develop an application for the National Kidney Foundation (NKF) targeted to individuals suffering from chronic kidney disease. 
-Helps users to track their intake of foods, liquids, and macronutrients essential to the prevention of the progression of the disease
-Used NutritionIX database power search function to display common foods
-Designed widgets using Flutter to display a percentage of macronutrients consumed as tracker updates
-Updated Firebase database with user information
-Worked as Project Partner Liaison and directly communicated with senior NKF representatives to ensure app function aligned with needs
positions.insights: Skills: Dart · Flutter · Firebase · Mobile Applications · Project Management

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
-Software engineer intern on the Engineering team at PerkSpot. 
-Delivered an ML project to serve users custom offer recommendations
-Researched and implemented an instance of Azure Intelligent Recommendations (IR) tool. 
-Modeled relevant user activity data for data ingestion process using SQL. 
-Created screen in React to intuitively show a user’s recommended offers based on the results consumed from IR API.
-Helped plan a company-wide charity event that spanned several days to support Children's First Fund

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Software Engineer intern for the Sales Tools team.
*Worked on several aspects of Nucor's web pricing system, eQuote
*I collaborated with senior developers in the Scrum process
*Integrate commonality between several Nucor divisions
*Completed 15 PBI's that included dynamic UI changes, website maintenance, and updating features based on feedback from the product owner
*Completed feature that checks a project and its buildings for a list of specifications before allowing it to be priced at a discount
*Gained experience across several languages and software tools including C#, ASP.NET, Visual Studio, Excel Macros, and SQL.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET · Visual Basic · SQL · Web Development

positions.title: Code Sensei
positions.description: Mentor and assist kids from ages 7-14 how to program and build games in Scratch and JavaScript. Lead and help develop curriculum for summer camps that have a variety of STEM focuses - robotics, Python, 3D Printing, CAD, Microbits

educations.schoolName: CIEE Council on International Educational Exchange

honors.description: 2022 Recipient of the Zillion Women in STEM scholarship

organizations.name: BoilerMake
organizations.description: Design Team member for the student group that organizes the largest hackathon at Purdue. I use Affinity Designer to create original designs for the digital media and physical aspects of the event.
